title: chrysopogon philippinensis
intro: Chrysopogon philippinensis, commonly known as Vettiver or Khas or Khus, is a type of grass native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The health benefits of Chrysopogon philippinensis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents of Chrysopogon philippinensis include essential oils, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
